title: Cohomology of an affine smooth curve with roots of unity
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the etale cohomology of an affine smooth curve over an algebraically closed field with coefficients in the roots of unity: the degree zero group is the roots of unity in the field, the first group is free of rank twice the genus plus the number of removed points minus one, and the higher groups vanish (statement lines 11245-11258). The proof is a complete computation: the curve is expressed as the complement of finitely many points in a compactification and divisibility of the Picard group together with the Kummer sequence gives the degree zero group and the vanishing in degrees at least two (proof lines 11261-11267); the first cohomology is described through triples and a displayed exact sequence comparing it with the compactification and the removed points, whose ranks are then counted (proof lines 11267-11302). The non-formal content is the description by triples and the rank count. The claim is H2: a computation with each input named.
